VTFrameProcessor.doc: A class that creates a new frame processor for the configured video effect.

VTFrameProcessorFrame.doc: An object that wraps video frames to send to the processor, as source, reference, or output frames.

VTFrameProcessorOpticalFlow.doc: A class to wrap bidirectional optical flow to send to the processor.

VTFrameRateConversionConfiguration.doc: An object that enables the frame rate conversion on a frame processing session.

VTFrameRateConversionParameters.doc: An object that contains the required input and output parameters to run a frame rate conversion processor on a frame.

VTLowLatencyFrameInterpolationConfigurat.doc: Configuration that you use to program Video Toolbox frame processor for low-latency frame interpolation.

VTLowLatencyFrameInterpolationParameters.doc: An object that contains both input and output parameters that the low-latency frame interpolation processor needs.

VTLowLatencySuperResolutionScalerConfigu.doc: An object you use to configure frame processor for low-latency super-resolution scaler processing.

VTLowLatencySuperResolutionScalerParamet.doc: An object that contains both input and output parameters that the low-latency super-resolution scaler frame processor needs.

VTMotionBlurConfiguration.doc: A configuration object to enable motion blur on a frame processing session.

VTMotionBlurParameters.doc: This object contains both input and output parameters necessary to run the motion blur processor on a frame.

VTOpticalFlowConfiguration.doc: A configuration object that enables optical flow on a frame processing session.

VTOpticalFlowParameters.doc: An object that describes frame-level optical flow parameters.

VTSuperResolutionScalerConfiguration.doc: Configuration that you use to set up the super-resolution processor.

VTSuperResolutionScalerParameters.doc: An object that contains both input and output parameters that the super-resolution processor needs to run on a frame.

VTTemporalNoiseFilterConfiguration.doc: A configuration object to initiate a frame processor and use temporal noise-filter processor.

VTTemporalNoiseFilterParameters.doc: Encapsulates the frame-level parameters necessary for processing a source frame using temporal noise-filter processor.

VTFrameProcessorConfiguration.doc: A protocol that describes the configuration of a processor to use during a video processing session.

VTFrameProcessorParameters.doc: The base protocol for input and output processing parameters for a frame processor implementation.

VTCompressionSessionOptionFlags.doc: Flags to pass to a compression session.

init(rawValue:).doc: Creates a flags structure with a raw value.

kVTCompressionSessionBeginFinalPass.doc: A flag that indicates the last pass in a multi-pass compression session.

VTDecodeFrameFlags.doc: Flags to pass to a decompression session and the video decoder.

init(rawValue:).doc: Creates a flags structure with a raw value.

kVTDecodeFrame_1xRealTimePlayback.doc: A flag that provides a hint to the video decoder that it’s ok to use a low-power mode that can’t decode faster than realtime.

kVTDecodeFrame_DoNotOutputFrame.doc: A flag that provides a hint to the decompression session and video decoder not to return a frame.

kVTDecodeFrame_EnableAsynchronousDecompr.doc: A flag that indicates to enable asynchronous decompression.

kVTDecodeFrame_EnableTemporalProcessing.doc: A flag that indicates to enable temporal processing.

VTDecodeInfoFlags.doc: Flags that provide information about the status of a decode operation.

init(rawValue:).doc: Creates a flag from a raw unsigned-integer value.

kVTDecodeInfo_Asynchronous.doc: A flag that indicates the decode operation ran asynchronously.

kVTDecodeInfo_FrameDropped.doc: A flag that indicates the decode operation dropped a frame.

kVTDecodeInfo_ImageBufferModifiable.doc: A flag that indicates the image buffer is safe to modify.

kVTDecodeInfo_SkippedLeadingFrameDropped.doc: A flag that indicates whether the decode process skips leading frames after dropping a synchronization frame.

init(rawValue:).doc: Creates a flags structure with a raw value.

kVTEncodeInfo_Asynchronous.doc: A flag that indicates that an encode operation ran asynchronously.

kVTEncodeInfo_FrameDropped.doc: A flag that indicates that a frame dropped during encoding.

VTMotionEstimationFrameFlags.doc: Flags to control processing of a frame you pass to the motion-estimation session.

kVTMotionEstimationFrameFlags_CurrentBuf.doc: A hint to the motion-estimation session that you are going to reuse the currentBuffer as referenceBuffer in the next call to VTMotionEstimationSessionEstimateMotionVectors. Using this flag allows the motion-estimation processor to deliver better performance.

VTMotionEstimationInfoFlags.doc: Directives that provide information back to you with the results of motion-estimation.

VTInt32Point.doc: A structure that represents a 32-bit integer point value.

VTInt32Size.doc: A structure that represents a 32-bit integer size value.

-endSession.doc: Performs all necessary tasks to end the session.

-processWithCommandBuffer:parameters:.doc: Asynchronously performs the video effect specified in the start session specifically for Metal.

-processWithParameters:completionHandler.doc: Asynchronously performs the video effect specified in the start session.

-processWithParameters:error:.doc: Synchronously performs the configured video effect.

-processWithParameters:frameOutputHandle.doc: Asynchronously performs the processor effects and outputs each frame separately.

-startSessionWithConfiguration:error:.doc: Starts a new session and configures the processor pipeline.

-initWithBuffer:presentationTimeStamp:.doc: Creates a frame object with a pixel buffer and presentation time.

-initWithForwardFlow:backwardFlow:.doc: Creates an object with forward and backward optical flow pixel buffers.

-initWithFrameWidth:frameHeight:usePreco.doc: Creates a new frame rate conversion configuration with specified flow width and height.

-initWithSourceFrame:nextFrame:opticalFl.doc: Creates a new frame rate conversion parameters object.

+maximumDimensionForSpatialScaleFactor:.doc: The maximum value for either dimension of the source frame, in pixels, for a given spatial scale factor.

+maximumPixelCountForSpatialScaleFactor:.doc: The maximum total number of pixels in the source frame for a given spatial scale factor.

-initWithFrameWidth:frameHeight:numberOf.doc: Creates a new low-latency frame interpolation configuration for frame-rate conversion.

-initWithFrameWidth:frameHeight:spatialS.doc: Creates a new low-latency frame interpolation configuration for spatial scaling and temporal scaling.

-initWithSourceFrame:previousFrame:inter.doc: Creates a new low-latency frame interpolation parameters object.

+supportedScaleFactorsForFrameWidth:fram.doc: Returns an array of supported scale factors values, or an empty list if the processor doesn’t support the dimensions.

-initWithFrameWidth:frameHeight:scaleFac.doc: Creates a new low-latency super-resolution scaler configuration with specified frame width and height.

-initWithSourceFrame:destinationFrame:.doc: Creates a new low-latency, super-resolution scaler parameters object.

-initWithFrameWidth:frameHeight:usePreco.doc: Creates a new motion blur configuration with specified flow width and height.

-downloadConfigurationModelWithCompletio.doc: Downloads models that the system needs for the current configuration.

-initWithFrameWidth:frameHeight:scaleFac.doc: Creates a new super-resolution scaler processor configuration.

-initWithSourceFrame:previousFrame:previ.doc: Creates a new super-resolution scaler parameters instance.

-initWithFrameWidth:frameHeight:sourcePi.doc: Creates a new temporal noise-processor configuration.
